title: समाख्यानात्मक चलचित्रीकरणको सैद्धान्तिक स्वरूप {Theoretical aspects of narrative filmmaking}
nepali: प्रस्तुत अनुसन्धान लेख समाख्यान (पाठ) लाई चलचित्रको दृश्यभाषामा रूपान्तर गरिने सैद्धान्तिक पद्धतिमा आधारित छ । समाख्यान (आख्यान) मा कथावाचन गर्न आएको वक्ता समाख्याता हो भने त्यस समाख्याताको स्थानमा क्यामराको लेन्सलाई केन्द्रित गरेर दृश्यमा छायाङ्कन गर्ने पद्धति समाख्यानको चलचित्रीकरण हो । प्रस्तुत लेखको शीर्षक सोद्देश्यमूलक रूपले चयन गरिएको हो । समाख्यानलाई चलचित्रमा रूपान्तर गर्न प्रयोग गरिने पद्धतिसम्बद्ध सामग्रीलाई यस लेखमा मुख्य सैद्धान्तिक पर्याधार बनाइएको छ । समाख्यानलाई चलचित्रमा रूपान्तर गर्दा प्रयोग गरिएका प्राविधिक पक्ष र त्यसका सैद्धान्तिक सामग्री तथा तिनका बिचको तुलना एवं प्रतितुलना गरेर विश्लेषण प्रारूप तयार गरिएको छ । त्यसैले यस अनुसन्धान लेखमा निगमनात्मक तथा आगमनात्मक विधिको संयोजित प्रारूप प्रयोग गरिएको छ । प्रस्तुत लेखमा सामग्रीको स्रोत पुस्तकालय हो । समाख्यानशास्त्र र चलचित्र सिद्धान्त सम्बद्ध सामग्री प्राथमिक रूपमा प्रयोग गरिएका छन् भने अन्य आख्यानमा आधारित पाठ एवं तिनमा केन्द्रित श्रव्यदृश्य सामग्री द्वितीयक रूपमा प्रयोग गरिएका छन् । समाख्यान (आख्यानयुक्त पाठ) लाई चलचित्रको दृश्यभाषामा रूपान्तर गर्दा मुख्यतः सांस्कृतिक दृश्यगत आधार (पाठबाट प्राप्त हु्ने अमूर्त विश्वास तथा पाठीय सन्दर्भमा त्यसको स्वाभाविकता), कथानकको भौगोलिक दृश्यगत (पाठले सन्दर्भित गरेका भौतिक वस्तु तथा द्रवयान्त्रिकी) आधार, पाठको आन्तरिक सन्दर्भ (पाठमा आएका सन्दर्भको पारस्परिक सम्बन्ध) को नक्साङ्कन तथा बाह्य पाठीय नक्साङ्कन (अलौकिक र अदृश्यमान सन्दर्भको काल्पनिकबिम्ब) लाई प्रयोजन र ललितको समन्वय गरेर तयार गरिन्छ । पाठीय सन्दर्भको संज्ञानलाई भर्चुअल बनाउने प्रक्रियाको अन्तरविधात्मक प्रारूप यस लेखमा तयार भएको छ ।
american_english: The present research article is based on the theoretical method of converting narrative (text) into the visual language of film. In narrative (fiction), the speaker who comes to narrate the story is the narrator, and the method of filming in which the camera lens is centered in place of that narrator is the cinematization of the narrative. The title of the present article has been selected purposefully. The material concerning the method used to convert narrative into film has been made the main theoretical basis in this article. An analytical framework has been prepared by comparing and contrasting the technical aspects used in converting narrative into film, the theoretical material of those, and the relation between them. Therefore a combined framework of deductive and inductive methods has been used in this research article. The source of material in the present article is the library. Material related to narratology and film theory has been used primarily, while other texts based on fiction and the audiovisual material centered on them have been used secondarily. In converting narrative (a text with narrative) into the visual language of film, mainly the cultural visual basis (the abstract belief obtained from the text and its naturalness in the textual context), the geographical visual basis of the plot (the physical objects and mechanics referenced by the text), the internal context of the text (the mutual relation of the contexts appearing in the text) and its mapping, and the external textual mapping (the imaginary image of supernatural and invisible contexts) are prepared by coordinating purpose and aesthetics. An interdisciplinary framework of the process of virtualizing the cognition of textual context has been prepared in this article.

In narrative (fiction), the speaker who comes to narrate the story is the narrator, and filming with the camera lens centred in place of that narrator is how the narrative gets cinematized. The title of this article has been chosen purposefully. The material on the method used to turn narrative into film has been made the main theoretical basis in this article. An analytical framework has been put together by comparing and contrasting the technical aspects used in turning narrative into film, the theory behind them, and how they relate. So a combined deductive and inductive approach has been used in this research article. The source of material in this article is the library. In turning narrative (a text with narrative) into the visual language of film, what gets prepared, by coordinating purpose and aesthetics, is mainly the cultural visual basis (the abstract belief drawn from the text and its naturalness in the textual context), the geographical visual basis of the plot (the physical objects and mechanics the text refers to), the internal context of the text (how the contexts appearing in it relate to each other) and its mapping, and the external textual mapping (the imagined image of supernatural and unseen contexts). An interdisciplinary framework for the process of virtualizing the cognition of textual context has been prepared in this article.
informal_english: This research article is all about the theory behind turning a narrative (a text) into the visual language of film. In a narrative (fiction), the one who narrates the story is the narrator, and the way filming happens with the camera lens standing in for that narrator is what we call the cinematization of the narrative. The title was picked on purpose. The material on the method used to convert narrative into film has been taken as the main theoretical basis here. An analytical framework has been put together by comparing and contrasting the technical bits used in converting narrative into film, the theory behind them, and how they relate. So a combined deductive and inductive approach has been used in this research article. The source of material here is the library. Material on narratology and film theory has been used first and foremost, while other fiction-based texts and the audiovisual material built around them have been used secondarily. When a narrative (a text with a narrative) is turned into the visual language of film, what gets prepared, by coordinating purpose and aesthetics, is mainly the cultural visual basis (the abstract belief drawn from the text and its naturalness in the textual context), the geographical visual basis of the plot (the physical objects and mechanics the text refers to), the internal context of the text (how the contexts appearing in it relate to each other) and its mapping, and the external textual mapping (the imagined image of supernatural and unseen contexts). An interdisciplinary framework for the process of virtualizing the cognition of textual context has been prepared in this article.
